notes: Bounded matched pilot, not a guarantee of convergence or video quality.
Frozen production C256, original statistics, same source31069 online initialization and joint C256 objective for both arms.
baseline and oracle_geo have identical added adapter architecture; only the supplied condition differs.
oracle_geo is true-future-frame encoded geometry, potentially containing appearance information, not a deployable or pure-geometry result.
No GT future texture is a condition and no GT geometry is clamped into the sampled decoder state.
Whole-window causal encoding preserves shared history; geometry consistency is measured, never assumed from latent normalization.
Half of the selected training windows use a latent-change ranking, not semantic dynamic-object annotations.
All 64 source evaluation cases stay in the paired evaluation, including known AE/replay anomalies.
Independent geometry diagnostics may fail without blocking valid data preparation or the matched training arms.
The smoke has a separate namespace and three updates with fresh-process checkpoint restore.
